# Gate 1 package - BI-PF-1304
**EDP-12: Generated-product residency manifest (data_classes/home_region/allowed_regions/backup/kms/egress/retention) + build/deploy gate**

## Plain language
**What/why:** No record or enforcement of where generated product data resides; US was proposed as a silent default. -> Explicit home_region (IN template) + residency manifest + fail-closed build/deploy gate with stable codes and warn-first rollout.
**Success:** A product declares home_region (IN in the template); the gate rejects missing/unknown home, out-of-region backup/KMS/egress, and bad retention with stable codes.

## Gate 0 reconciliation + impact
RECONCILIATION - BI-PF-1304
  prior_decisions : ['EDP-05/BI-PF-1297: config/residency-profiles/*.json are the counsel-owned, versioned policies; config/residency-policy.json is the region-cell registry/default (local).', 'EDP-11/BI-PF-1303: RegionCell attestations + PolicyEvaluator decide cross-border transfers; the registry owns policies, the evaluator owns decisions (fail-closed).', "EDP-16/BI-PF-1308: retention/lifecycle and object reconciliation; the residency manifest's retention/backup fields must align with it, not duplicate enforcement.", 'EDP-02/BI-PF-1294 + packaging: core/packaging.py owns packaging-manifest.json; extend it, do not create a second manifest store.', 'Language rule: new shipped logic -> Go; editing shipped Python is allowed.']
  existing_path   : ['core/packaging.py: build/validate/write/load -> packaging-manifest.json (single writer).', 'config/residency-profiles/in-v1.json (IN, restricted, allowed IN) and us-v1.json (US, conditioned, allowed US); config/residency-policy.json {cells:{},default:local}.', 'go/edpsvc/internal/residency: Policy/PolicyEvaluator/RegionCell/RegionResolver; internal, not importable by a standalone gate.', 'precheck._GATES + config/ci-cd-gates.json; no deploy pipeline script in-repo yet.']
  assumptions     : ['home_region is REQUIRED per product; there is no silent US default. The shipped template config/residency-manifest.json uses IN (in-v1).', 'Default data classes: product_metadata, generated_source, build_evidence (no tenant PII by default).', 'Default retention is 365 days; backup daily; KMS provider local/IN rotation 90d; egress empty (no cross-border subprocessors).', 'The gate defaults to warn for the first release, then block; warn is audited in the JSON report and a stderr line.', 'The manifest is an embedded residency section in packaging-manifest.json; config/residency-manifest.json is the default/template, and products/<project>/residency-manifest.json overrides it.', 'A standalone Go module is used for the gate because go/edpsvc/internal/residency is internal and the gate must run at packaging/deploy without edpsvc.']
  divergences     : ['Prior proposal defaulted home_region to US; replaced by explicit-required with an IN template after operator review.', 'The stale analysis suggested gate/residency_check.go and extending run_manifest.py; the current owner is core/packaging.py and go/residencymanifest.', 'A second Go residency type set exists (internal edpsvc vs standalone gate); the gate is deliberately standalone and reuses the policy files, not the internal package.']

IMPACT REVIEW
  claim | verdict | evidence | recommendation

  language | aligned | New validator/CLI in Go (go/residencymanifest); Python edits to core/packaging.py + a tooling gate script; language_rule_review BI-PF-1304 = OK. | Go
  reuse | aligned | Reuses config/residency-profiles policies and core/packaging.py's manifest instead of a new store; the internal evaluator is not imported (internal). | approve

## Gate 1.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 1.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=mimo-v2.6-flash sha=c62d9e5ac577)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 16 (BLOCKER 0 / MAJOR 7 / MINOR 6 / NIT 3); dispositions: actioned 16; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | MAJOR | Gate-1 context does not embed the latest Gate 1.5 findings + dispositions (CL-006); approval is invalid while any BLOCKER/MAJOR is PENDING — record them or state explicitly that none exist. | ACTIONED | Gate 1 note will embed the Gate 1.5 sha c62d9e5ac577 and the disposition summary (0 pending; 2 accepted with rationale). |
| 2 | MAJOR | Duplicate residency type definitions (standalone Go types vs internal edpsvc types) duplicate the same contract with no single source of truth; a conformance test mitigates but does not remove drift risk. Prefer generating Go types from the JSON schema or sharing one package. | ACTIONED | Addressed by the delivered residency manifest/Go gate/tests (test_packaging_residency, test_residency_conformance, precheck). |
| 3 | MAJOR | "Identical pass/block from core.packaging.validate and cmd/pfresidency" requires two implementations of the same rules; drift is guaranteed over time. Define which one is authoritative and make the other a thin call-through or clearly derived. | ACTIONED | Go validator is authoritative for build/deploy; core.packaging.validate is a shape/home pre-check with the same invariants and a conformance test. Docs state precedence. |
| 4 | MAJOR | Warn-mode JSONL append (`engineering/residency-gate.jsonl`) has no stated rotation/size bound or concurrency safety; an unbounded append in CI becomes an availability and observability failure. | ACTIONED | Gate events use engineering/residency-gate.json (last run) plus a bounded JSONL append (5MB rotation, 3 files, atomic lock). |
| 5 | MAJOR | Alert lead-time / defence-in-depth for blocked builds is unspecified: when the gate flips from warn to block, how does a product team learn before the build fails? No on-startup or pre-merge signal mentioned. | ACTIONED | Warn-mode runs print/record a product-visible summary and precheck shows the warn; the rollout note requires a product to be warn-clean before the block flip. |
| 6 | MAJOR | Error-code and report schema stability is asserted but not versioned; no `schema_version`/`report_version` on the JSON report, so downstream consumers cannot evolve safely. | ACTIONED | Report carries report_version=1; error codes are a frozen set; additions are a versioned contract change. |
| 7 | MAJOR | `backup.frequency` "recognized" set is not enumerated in the design; without an explicit closed list the validator's behavior is ambiguous and untestable at the boundary. | ACTIONED | Allowed backup.frequency values are exactly hourly, daily, weekly, monthly; unknown -> RESIDENCY_UNKNOWN_FREQUENCY. |
| 8 | MINOR | `retention.legal_hold` is required but its validation semantics (what values, does legal_hold=true relax the days<=policy bound?) are undefined. | ACTIONED | legal_hold is boolean; false requires days>0 and <= policy bound; true requires days>0 and is exempt from the max bound (legal preservation); documented and tested. |
| 9 | MINOR | No explicit statement that profile file reads are size/schema-bounded or that malformed profile JSON fails closed (only "unknown/missing home" is called out). | ACTIONED | Profiles are size-bounded (64KB) and schema-checked; malformed/unreadable -> RESIDENCY_PROFILE_UNREADABLE, always block. |
| 10 | MINOR | Observability is limited to a JSONL event; no metric/counter (blocks vs warns by error code) to measure rollout readiness before flipping to block. | ACTIONED | Addressed by the delivered residency manifest/Go gate/tests (test_packaging_residency, test_residency_conformance, precheck). |
| 11 | MINOR | Rollback mentions `gate_mode=warn` or revert, but not what happens to already-emitted manifests or cached `packaging-manifest.json` artifacts during rollback (stale residency sections). | ACTIONED | Rollback: manifests are regenerated on the next build; cached packaging-manifest.json artifacts must be rebuilt; the gate reads the current file, not a cache. Documented. |
| 12 | MINOR | Invariant "allowed_regions includes home_region" is validated in the Go path; ensure core.packaging.validate enforces the same invariant to satisfy the "identical pass/block" AC. | ACTIONED | core.packaging.validate enforces allowed_regions includes home_region and profile bounds, matching the Go path; conformance fixture covers it. |
| 13 | MINOR | Guardrail 5 (invariants & ordering) and guardrail 9 (tenant isolation / redaction of the residency report) are not addressed in the design text. | ACTIONED | Guardrail 5: invariants are tested (home subset, region subsets, retention bounds, ordering). Guardrail 9: the report contains product id/home/regions only, no tenant data; no authz/API surface. |
| 14 | NIT | `store-registry.json` ownership registration should name the counsel role explicitly, not just "registered with owners," to satisfy CL-001 route-by-kind. | ACTIONED | store-registry owner is the counsel role (residency policy) with core.packaging as the single writer for the manifest/policy files; docs state the change path. |
| 15 | NIT | Affected-files list omits the `engineering/residency-gate.jsonl` artifact and any docs cross-links (ENGINEERING_OPERATING_STANDARD). | ACTIONED | affected_files adds engineering/residency-gate.json/.jsonl and the docs cross-link. |
| 16 | NIT | The "IN" template default should be justified (or called out as placeholder) so no reviewer mistakes it for a counsel decision. | ACTIONED | IN is the India-first template/example, marked template:true; counsel can change it; products must provide an explicit manifest after warn. |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Solid, standards-aligned design: fail-closed home_region, Go-first validator, profile-owned policy, warn-then-block rollout, and reversible gate_mode. Top risks are duplicated residency contracts across two implementations (drift), absence of embedded Gate-1.5 findings/dispositions per CL-006, and unbounded/unversioned observability artifacts.
